data.headline: What Are the 5 Best Bargain Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks to Buy Right Now?
data.summary: AMD, Broadcom, and Nvidia are all cheap chip stocks given their projected growth.  Salesforce and Adobe are two SaaS companies riding the AI wave that have fallen into the bargain bin.  One of the best ways to find bargains in a hot sector is to look beyond stocks' price-to-earnings (P/E) ratios and instead look at their price/earnings-to-growth (PEG) ratios, as this metric takes into consideration their earnings growth.
